newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 21.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on February 21. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Indonesia and Laos have agreed to develop a constructive and positive cooperation which could benefit the two countries. Indonesia's President Suharto is in Laos for a state visit.
Armed Forces Chief General Feisal Tanjung said the bloody ethnic conflict in West Kalimantan province was officially over since leaders of the warring parties signed a peace treaty on Tuesday.

Ousted leader of the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) Megawati Sukarnoputri has answered a police summons for a questioning in relation to a function she held at her house in January to celebrate the party's 24th anniversary.
Indonesia will send nearly 200,000 Moslems to Saudi Arabia for the 1997 haj pilgrimage.

Indonesia's Jakarta and Surabaya Stock Exchange have signed an agreement with Australian Stock Exchange in a bid to boost the integrity and efficiency of the securities markets in Australia and Indonesia.
